newsitem.title: USA: Osmonics files for 627,500 shr offering.
newsitem.headline: Osmonics files for 627,500 shr offering.

text.p: Osmonics Inc said Wednesday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed offering of 627,500 shares of common stock by certain shareholders.
The selling shareholders are principally individuals with companies recently acquired by Osmonics, the company said, adding that it is not selling any shares.
Cleary Gull Reiland and McDevitt will act as lead managing underwriter of the proposed offering.
Osmonics shares were trading at 19-5/8, down 3/8.
